result_text:
Folders named `mock…` or `__mock…` are now classified as mock-resources test code at any depth, including Windows-style backslash paths. The new and existing scoping tests pass.

**Change**

- `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java`: I replaced the two mock folder rules (`__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/` and `mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/`) with one rule, `(.*/)?(__)?mock[^/]*/.*`. The `[^/]*` lets the rest of the folder name be anything except a separator, so `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟` all match. The match stays inside one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` do not match. The old `mocks/` rule is untouched, so `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- I wrote the regex without backslash escapes on purpose. `SourceFileFilter` replaces `\` with `/` in the pattern as well as the path, so an escape would be mangled.
- `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventionsTest.java` is new. It runs the real `TestConventions` patterns against the positive cases (including the elasticsearch path), the previously-matched folders, and the negative cases.

**Verification**

- `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest=TestConventionsTest,SourceFileFilterTest`: the surefire reports show 3 and 6 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors.
- No other test or fixture in `codeanalyzer/src/test` mentions "mock", so I did not run the full module suite.

Nothing is committed.
